THE HALDEN RANGE

THREE STEPS, NO MORE

Cleanse, repair, protect. Everything else on a bathroom shelf is either one of these three wearing a different label, or nothing at all.

01 / Barrier Serum

Barrier Serum

Niacinamide at 5%, panthenol, oat lipids. Repairs what winter takes.

30ml · Morning and night

02 / Glacier Cream

Glacier Cream

WHAT IS INSIDE

TWELVE THINGS, COUNTED

Every ingredient is listed at its real percentage on the carton. If something is in there at a level too low to work, it is not in there.

Cold-Pressed Lipids

Oat and sunflower lipids pressed without heat, so the fatty acids that rebuild the barrier arrive intact.

Named Actives

Niacinamide at 5%, panthenol at 3%. Printed on the box, because a percentage you cannot see is a claim, not a dose.

Nothing Decorative

No fragrance, no colourant, no botanical added at 0.01% for the ingredient list. Twelve ingredients, all of them working.

HOW TO USE

DONE IN THREE MINUTES.

01

Cleanse

Birch oil onto dry skin, warm water to lift it off. Once at night is enough, twice is too much.

02

Repair

Four drops of Barrier Serum on damp skin, pressed rather than rubbed. Give it thirty seconds.

03

Protect

Glacier Cream over the top, more of it in the coldest months. That is the entire routine.

OUR STORY

MADE FOR THE DARK HALF

Halden began in a town where the sun clears the roofline for about four hours in December, and every skincare routine anybody owned quietly stopped working around the middle of January.

So we cut the shelf down to what survives a real winter: three formulas, twelve ingredients, doses printed on the box. Everything that was there for the marketing came out.

GOOD QUESTIONS

YOUR QUESTIONS

The things people ask before the first order, answered without the marketing voice.

Will this work on sensitive skin?

It was formulated for it. No fragrance, no essential oils, no denatured alcohol. If your skin reacts to most things, this is the shorter list.

Do I need all three?

No. The Barrier Serum does the most work and stands on its own. The other two make it last longer through a hard winter.

Why are the percentages on the box?

Because an active at an unstated dose tells you nothing. Ours are printed where you can read them before you buy.

Is the packaging recyclable?

The glass, the aluminium lids and the cartons all are. The pumps are the one part that is not yet, and we are working on it.
